_what: The starting looks for anything that moves with sound (a background behind the panes, the Ambience screen, lights following along): each look's words, the motion it moves in (`motion`, a painter in parts/ui/show/sound-signal/sound-painters.ts), its colours in order (`palette`: the first is the main colour, lights take theirs from the same list), the ground it is painted on (`ground`, or null to let the screen's own look show through), how strongly it answers the sound (`strength`, 0 to 1) and how fast it drifts (`speed`). A person's own look is the same shape, kept with the layer or the screen that wears it. A new starting look is one row here.

looks.label: Popcorn
looks.about: Kernels that pop on the beat, jump and pile up.

looks.label: Sparkles
looks.about: Warm sparks that burst on every beat.

looks.label: Thread
looks.about: Trillion's red, breathing behind your work.

looks.label: Aurora
looks.about: Soft northern lights that swell with the music.

looks.label: Night drive
looks.about: Lines of light that ripple like a car's dashboard at night.

looks.label: Paper
looks.about: A quiet ink wash for working in daylight.
